Credit to "IO_BUTOV for creating the FREE SPACE FLIEGENDER KOMMANDANT BUG" and the "MODERN BODYS COMPATIBLE WITH THE ORIGINAL WARRIOR" which I modified to create the opened winged bodies.

The supported files are untested so I do not know how well they will print out. But I do have a good track record of supporting models so they should print out OK.

These are just the bodies. They are compatible with the official kits and they compatible with IO_BUTOV's various models. Such as "MODERN TAIL COMPATIBLE WITH THE ORIGINAL WARRIOR", "MODERN LEGS COMPATIBLE WITH THE ORIGINAL WARRIOR", "MODERN HEADS COMPATIBLE WITH THE ORIGINAL WARRIOR" and "TEST MODEL OF THE WARRIOR BUG FROM FUTURE FREE SET" for the claws.

The last time I made winged bodies they resulting models would knock into each other and they have a hard time staying in base contact with each other. However I have made some changes to the wings so they are at different positions/elevations so hopefully they will not knock into each other as much but no promises.

WingForModification is just a single wing that is so if you want to you can do your own reposing or your own digital kitbashes.

If you have any issues or questions message me and I can see what I can do.

This .STL library is meant as a space bug Terrornid Guard original model and needs to be printed on an SLA printer.

.STL library to create various SBoD Terrornid Guard bits, they fit on a 50mm base (not included, check out my base pack). Library features:

- Heads 3 types 4 poses
- Torso 2 types
- Shoulders 2 types 4 sub variants
- Tail Variants 2 types 6 poses
- Back Legs 1 types 6 poses
- Front Legs 1 types 6 poses 1 sub variant
- Talons L&R 6 poses
- Crushing Claws L&R 6 poses
- Shields L&R 3 poses
- Swords L&R 6 poses
- Whips L&R 3 poses

Everything should be interchangeable between poses. Specific pose X legs and tails fits best together. Can be combined between poses but you might end up with wonky feet.
